nodes.label: pre-push hook
nodes.rationale: Auto fetch + merge remote branch and origin/main before push so concurrent AGENTS.md edits do not conflict; on merge, re-pushes itself with PRE_PUSH_RUNNING=1 guard and exits 1 to abort the stale original push.

nodes.label: Git Merge Conflict Prevention
nodes.rationale: Multiple contributors/agents edit AGENTS.md concurrently: sequential append-only, atomic status edits, and pre-push sync hook minimize conflicts.

nodes.label: Git & Team Rules for Speed
nodes.rationale: Short-lived feat/* branches, no GitFlow; deploy to Vercel/Render at hour 2 to catch CORS/build/env issues early; keep .env.example in frontend/ and backend/.

nodes.label: USE_MOCK Toggle
nodes.rationale: Requester wires mock fixtures from requested JSON so frontend progress never stalls; flipped to false at verification.

nodes.label: API Specification (Shared Contract)
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth for FE/BE contracts; XREQ contracts promoted here once fulfilled and verified, giving a permanent record.

nodes.label: Daily Entry Template
nodes.rationale: Newest entry first, UTC+6, sections Completed/Next/Blockers/Related so teammates avoid overlapping work.

nodes.label: AGENTS.md Protocol
nodes.rationale: Chosen as primary file because AGENTS.md is the industry-standard root instruction file parsed by coding agents (Antigravity, Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Copilot). Single source of truth so humans coordinate async and agents discover blockers without explicit prompts.

nodes.label: Cross-Functional Protocol Plan
nodes.rationale: Primary bottleneck in multi-contributor sprints is cross-team dependency resolution; plan builds a machine-readable + human-friendly OS for the repo.

nodes.label: TEAM_INSTRUCTIONS.md Alias
nodes.rationale: Secondary alias so humans and doc links navigate interchangeably to AGENTS.md.

nodes.label: XREQ Queue
nodes.rationale: Bidirectional contract ledger; one unambiguous place for schemas, endpoints, mocks. Kept under 10 active items for fast agent context loading.

nodes.label: Component B: XREQ Queue
nodes.rationale: Queue placed at top of file for immediate parsing; adds ARCHIVED terminal state after VERIFIED_AND_CLOSED.

nodes.label: Maximum Priority Mode
nodes.rationale: Speed over perfection: return mock data adhering to contract immediately, then wire business logic, unblocking requester in minutes.

nodes.label: Step-0 Rule
nodes.rationale: Cross-functional dependencies always override isolated feature work; velocity dies from unresolved cross-team blockers, so agents must scan the XREQ queue before any backlog task.

nodes.label: XREQ Lifecycle States
nodes.rationale: PENDING -> IN_PROGRESS -> RESOLVED -> VERIFIED_AND_CLOSED. RESOLVED requires proof (branch/commit/verification) so nothing is closed without evidence; requester closes after switching USE_MOCK=false.

nodes.label: minhaz.md Legacy Alias
nodes.rationale: Legacy pointer kept after work log moved to standardized <Contributor>/WORK_LOG.md pattern.

nodes.label: Recommended Monorepo Structure
nodes.rationale: Single repo so commits, branches, shared schemas visible to whole team.

nodes.label: Contract-First Development
nodes.rationale: If frontend waits on backend endpoints, dev time halves. Agree on JSON contract in hour 0-1, work in parallel against mocks, integrate 1-2 hours before end (under 30 min if both adhered).

nodes.label: Backend Team Directives
nodes.rationale: 15-30 min response SLA; CORS globally allowed in dev; endpoints must appear in Swagger; never rename/remove response key without XREQ to Frontend.

nodes.label: Backend Playbook
nodes.rationale: Enable CORS immediately; test via FastAPI /docs or Postman independently of frontend.

nodes.label: Recommended Tech Stacks
nodes.rationale: A: Next.js+Tailwind+shadcn (unified TS, Vercel). B: Vite+React+FastAPI (Python AI ecosystem, auto Swagger). C: Supabase/Firebase BaaS (skips ~80% backend boilerplate).

nodes.label: No Silent Breaking Changes
nodes.rationale: Backend altering payload without notice causes integration failure; mandatory breaking changes get P0 XREQ so Frontend updates models immediately.
